steps.en: Initialize a separate vault through a reviewed plan and load the plugin
steps.zh: 审查计划后建立独立笔记库并加载插件

steps.en: Place a source in inbox and request ingestion
steps.zh: 把来源放入收件箱并请求收录

steps.en: Draft linked notes, source records and one operation bundle
steps.zh: 起草关联笔记、来源记录和统一操作包

steps.en: Review the bundle and approve its exact hash
steps.zh: 审查操作包并批准其准确哈希

steps.en: Apply coordinated writes and report the changed paths
steps.zh: 协调写入并报告改变的路径

value.en: Sources and linked knowledge persist together in a reviewable vault
value.zh: 来源与关联知识共同保存在可审查的笔记库
